s: A spring meadow full of blossom; two scholars' robes lie folded on the grass, one blue and one pale pink, while two luminous butterflies, one deep blue and one warm rose, spiral upward together above the flowers, wings catching sunlight; petals drift, soft golden backlight, gentle romantic mood, no people visible.

A riverside mudflat at dawn; a bearded man in a rough animal-hide cloak over a hemp robe crouches, tracing shapes in the wet sand with a stick, eyes alight with sudden discovery; around his marks, clear bird and animal footprints pattern the mud; a clay pot and a knotted rope lie abandoned behind him. Low golden light, reeds, mist.

A snowy plain under a pale sky; a man in a fur-lined hide cloak kneels in fresh snow, one hand sweeping aside powder to reveal clear bird tracks, the other holding a sharpened stick; he looks up at the sky with wide inspired eyes; a scroll of knotted cords lies forgotten at his knee. Blue-white tones, soft snowfall, distant mountains.

A towering rocky gorge with a waterfall thundering down; a small orange carp arcs through the air at the top of the falls, body curving, scales flashing gold as light breaks over it, tiny dragon horns just beginning to shimmer on its head; spray and mist, rainbows in the water droplets, many other carp watching from the churning pool below.

A moonlit courtyard with an osmanthus tree; a woman in flowing white and pale-blue layered robes with long ribbons and an elaborate high bun floats upward, sleeves and hair streaming, one hand reaching back down, expression both wonder and sorrow; below, a strong archer in a red-brown robe runs forward with arms outstretched. A huge round moon fills the sky, silver light.

Night sky above tiled rooftops: a woman in layered white silk with wide trailing sleeves rises toward a vast bright moon, her long ribbons spiralling around her, face turned back with a wistful smile; far below a man in a dark archer's robe stands alone in a courtyard, one arm lifted, the other holding a small empty box. Stars, drifting clouds, silver-blue palette.

A bridge of hundreds of magpies arcs across the starry Milky Way; on it a young man in a simple blue farmhand robe and a woman in a soft pink and lilac immortal's dress with flowing ribbons run toward each other, hands outstretched, faces bright with joy; magpies crowd the bridge edges, wings spread, a river of stars behind.

A dragon king's temple courtyard during a drought ceremony; farmers in straw capes and patched robes beat a drum and hold up incense, faces hopeful and anxious; above the tiled roof a majestic oriental dragon with turquoise scales and golden antlers coils through low rain clouds, one claw raised, rain beginning to fall in silver sheets. Cracked earth, wilting crops, dramatic sky.

A cave mouth at dusk in prehistoric times; a bearded man in a rough hide tunic kneels over a wooden stick spun between his palms into a flat piece of dry wood, cheeks puffed with effort, a tiny thread of smoke rising; beside him a pile of dry tinder and flint stones, and behind him a family in fur wraps watches with wide eyes. Warm ember glow, cave walls.

A celestial peach orchard in the clouds; a monkey king in golden armour with a red cape and a feathered headband sits high in a blossoming peach tree, one leg swinging, biting into a huge peach with a defiant grin; below, celestial guards in silver armour tumble backwards among scattered peach baskets, and a golden cudgel lies casually across a branch. Pink petals, cloud sea.

A bare rocky summit above cracked earth; a powerful archer in a red-brown leather tunic and fur boots draws a huge bow to full tension, one eye shut, jaw clenched, muscles straining; in the burning sky nine blazing suns with angry faces are struck and falling as streaks of fire, one sun remains behind, pale and frightened. Heat haze, dry wind, dramatic light.

A rocky cliff above a vast blue sea; a small bird with a white head, red beak and dark wings hovers with a pebble and a twig in its beak, determined eyes fixed on the water far below; behind it green mountains; below, an enormous wave curls up with a sneering foam face. Strong wind, spray, dramatic scale contrast between tiny bird and huge ocean.

A giant in a simple hide wrap strides across a vast landscape, one enormous hand reaching toward a huge glowing sun low on the horizon, face streaked with sweat but grinning with resolve; beneath his feet rivers look like silver threads, mountains like small stones, a dry riverbed behind him; his wooden staff planted in the ground has begun sprouting peach blossoms. Golden-red sky.

A stone-arched bridge over a misty West Lake; a graceful woman in flowing white robes with a jade hairpin holds a folded oil-paper umbrella, smiling gently; opposite her a young scholar in a pale blue robe and scholar's cap bows slightly, startled and charmed; willows trail in the water, lotus leaves, distant pagoda in the mist, soft rain.

At the foot of a huge mountain split by a glowing crack; a determined boy in a red and gold short robe and cloth boots grips a luminous lotus-shaped lantern in one hand and a glowing axe in the other, feet planted, face streaked with dust but fierce with hope; warm light pours from the split rock, illuminating his face. Rocks, dust, dramatic glow.

Raging sea with towering waves; a small fierce boy with two hair buns, a red silk sash streaming around him, a golden ring in one hand, mid-leap above the water, expression bold and delighted; below, dragon soldiers with fish and crab features tumble backwards in panic, and a huge green dragon head rears up with bulging eyes. Spray, foam, dynamic diagonal motion.

The bank of a wide yellow river at soft dawn; a goddess with a human head and a serpent's lower body, dressed in flowing pale green and gold robes, kneels and shapes a small clay figure with gentle hands, her face full of tenderness; around her feet dozens of tiny laughing clay people dance and clap. Wet clay, reeds, warm light, a vine dipped in mud nearby.

A vast cracked sky with a jagged hole pouring down light and water; a goddess with a serpent's tail and flowing robes stands on a peak, holding a glowing mass of five-coloured molten stone in both hands, its light reflecting on her determined face; below, a giant turtle's four legs stand as pillars at the corners of the earth. Rainbow colours, steam, dramatic clouds.

A celestial river crossing under a golden sky; an honest brown ox wades steadily through the water, and a tiny clever mouse sits perched on its horn, ready to leap; on the far bank a jade emperor in gold-trimmed robes stands beside twelve floating banners, one for each animal; a tiger, rabbit, dragon and snake are visible approaching in the distance. Cloud sea, festive mood.

A colossal giant in a simple hide wrap stands between a rising sky and a thickening earth, arms braced wide and legs planted, muscles straining, face calm and enduring; a massive axe lies at his feet; above him swirling light separates from heavy dark matter, stars beginning to form. Epic scale, deep blue-gold palette, cosmic drama.

A colossal giant in a hide wrap holds the sky up with both arms, head tilted back, jaw set, as the heavens arch higher and the earth spreads below; his long hair blows into storm clouds, his breath becomes wind, and around him mountains rise from his form. A giant axe rests against a peak. Vast cosmic landscape, cool blues and warm gold light.

A terraced mountain slope full of wild plants; a lean man in a rough hemp tunic and straw sandals kneels, chewing a green leaf with a thoughtful, slightly wry expression, one hand already reaching for another herb; a woven basket of leaves and roots at his side, a jade-green glow faintly surrounding his body; distant fields of grain and farmers. Bright daylight.

A dark mountain lake under a starless sky; a brave young hunter in a simple hide vest and a young woman in a patterned cloth dress stand back to back on a rock, holding a golden axe and a golden scissors up toward two enormous dark dragons coiling in the sky; in the dragons' claws glow a sun and a moon. Tension, moonlight, spray, dramatic composition.

Two figures separated by a shimmering silver river of stars: on the left bank a young man in a blue farmhand robe holds the reins of an ox, reaching out helplessly; on the right a woman in soft pink immortal robes with long ribbons reaches back, tears in her eyes; between them a flock of magpies flies in, already forming a bridge. Deep night blue, glowing stars.

A turbulent sea under a bright sky, with eight colourful figures each riding their own vessel across the waves: a gourd, a flower basket, a paper donkey, a sword, a fan, a lotus, a flute and a castanet; each immortal wears distinct flowing robes in jade, crimson, gold and white, laughing and gesturing to one another; sea spray, cloud, a distant banquet pavilion on a cliff.

A young boy in a red and gold short robe stands on a mountain trail with a glowing lotus lantern raised high, its warm light illuminating a narrow path between dark cliffs; he carries a small pack and a wooden staff, expression tired but determined, chin lifted; behind him a deep valley and a distant peak split by a beam of light. Heroic, warm glow.

A snowy village lane on New Year's Eve; red couplets on every door, red lanterns glowing, children in padded red jackets holding their ears as firecrackers pop with bright sparks; at the edge of the frame a big blue-green furry monster with round eyes and small horns turns away, covering its face with a paw, scared of the noise and red colour. Festive, warm, playful.

A village gate at night in winter; a family in padded cotton jackets hangs a red couplet on the door and lights a red lantern while a child waves a sparkler; just outside the gate a shaggy blue-grey monster with wide frightened eyes recoils from the red light and sparks, one paw raised. Snow, warm orange glow, cheerful and slightly comic.

A celestial race finish line on a cloud bank; a sturdy brown ox steps onto the shore while a tiny mouse leaps from its horn toward the finish ribbon, both mid-action, the mouse's face gleeful; behind them a tiger bounds through clouds, a rabbit hops, and a dragon coils above; jade emperor in gold robes watches with an amused smile, holding a scroll. Festive colours, clouds, motion.

A herbal medicine shop on a Hangzhou street; a gentle woman in white robes with a jade pin grinds herbs with a mortar and pestle, smiling warmly at an old woman patient; a young scholar in a blue robe arranges drawers of herbs behind the counter, glancing at her fondly; shelves of drawers, hanging dried herbs, warm afternoon light through the door.

A mountain path with bare twisted trees; a monkey-faced warrior in golden armour and red cape stands protectively in front of a monk in an orange-brown robe and a pig-faced companion, his golden cudgel raised, eyes glowing with a fiery golden light as he stares down a swirling white skeletal shape half-hidden in mist; his expression is fierce and certain.

A moon palace courtyard with a huge osmanthus tree, its bark scarred with countless axe marks yet perfectly smooth again; a muscular man in a simple grey work robe swings a large axe, sleeves rolled, sweat on his brow, expression weary but stubborn; silvery petals drift down, a jade rabbit watches from a stone bench. Cool silver-blue light, quiet melancholy.

A flooded river plain with workers in simple hemp clothes digging a channel with wooden spades; a tall man in a dark blue robe with mud-stained hem stands on a dyke pointing along the channel's line, face weathered and resolute, holding a measuring cord; water flows into the new channel toward distant hills. Grey sky, mist, earth tones, determination.

A mountain gorge where a wide river is being guided into a carved channel; a determined man in a plain dark robe with rolled sleeves stands ankle-deep in mud, one hand on a wooden survey pole, the other gesturing along the water's path; labourers behind him carry baskets of stone; behind him, on a distant hill, a small house with a lit window that he is walking away from. Overcast, earthy palette.
